items.name: Coda Bassocyst
items.description: Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.

items.name: Coda Bubonico
items.description: With increased magazine size, the Coda Bubonico was born of the Technocyte virus' need to spread infection. Primary Fire rate ramps up with continuous fire.

items.name: Coda Catabolyst
items.description: When the magazine reaches empty and is manually reloaded, the Coda Catabolyst launches not one but three powerful grenades. Also has a higher Status Chance, Damage, and Magazine Size.

items.name: Coda Caustacyst
items.description: The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.

items.name: Coda Hema
items.description: The Technocyte virus did nothing but increase the Hema’s thirst for blood. With increased Fire Rate, Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

items.name: Coda Hirudo
items.description: Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.

items.name: Coda Mire
items.description: The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.

items.name: Coda Motovore
items.description: Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.

items.name: Coda Pathocyst
items.description: Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, enemy-seeking miasmites.

items.name: Coda Pox
items.description: These festering, writhing, throwable projectiles of pus and gas have been improved with a greater Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

items.name: Coda Sporothrix
items.description: Delivers a virus-laden barb to its victim that continues to damage it before exploding. With increased Damage, Reload Speed, Magazine Size, Status Chance, and explosion radius.

items.name: Coda Synapse
items.description: Firing a nonstop stream of vile corrosive gastric juice, the Coda Synapse comes with increased Magazine size, Beam Length, Status Chance, Punch Through, and Damage.

items.name: Coda Tysis
items.description: The Technocyte virus has contorted this Tysis into a more lethal weapon. With increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Magazine Capacity.

items.name: Convectrix
items.description: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.

items.name: Corinth
items.description: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.

items.name: Corinth Prime
items.description: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.

items.name: Felarx
items.description: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.

items.name: Innodem
items.description: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.

items.name: Kulstar
items.description: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.

items.name: Kuva Ayanga
items.description: Sweep aside hordes of enemies with flaming fury of this powerful, automatic, grenade launching archgun.

items.name: Kuva Brakk
items.description: This Lich-variant semi-automatic hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package. Higher fire rate, magazine capacity and reload speed.

items.name: Kuva Bramma
items.description: This Grineer bow delivers vengeance in the form of clusterbomb-tipped arrows that can be detonated mid-air or on impact. Low quiver capacity, arrows are recovered singly.

items.name: Kuva Chakkhurr
items.description: Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.

items.name: Kuva Drakgoon
items.description: The Kuva Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room that do not slow down. Larger Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

items.name: Kuva Ghoulsaw
items.description: The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.

items.name: Kuva Grattler
items.description: Reconfigured for maximum lethality, the Kuva Grattler still shatters targets with explosive shells, but now reaches maximum fire-rate instantaneously.

items.name: Kuva Hek
items.description: Forged at the behest of the Worm Queen herself, this already powerful shotgun now has the additional ability to fire from all four barrels simultaneously.

items.name: Kuva Hind
items.description: This powerful Grineer burst rifle has been retrofitted to add semi-automatic and automatic fire modes.

items.name: Kuva Karak
items.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. It has greater reload speed, lower recoil and greater accuracy than the standard-issue Karak rifle.

items.name: Kuva Kohm
items.description: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

items.name: Kuva Kraken
items.description: A custom variant that fires three quick shots with a single pull of the trigger, or can alt-fire burst the remainder of its magazine. Higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed.

items.name: Kuva Nukor
items.description: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.

items.name: Kuva Ogris
items.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. Unlike the basic version the Kuva Ogris fires detonite-infused casings semi-automatically, from a smaller magazine, while dealing greater damage per shot.

items.name: Kuva Quartakk
items.description: Unlike a standard Quartakk this Kuva Lich variant fires automatically from the hip while retaining its signature feature when aimed: annihilating targets with four simultaneous shots.

items.name: Kuva Seer
items.description: This variant pistol has higher fire rate and magazine capacity. Superior zoom capabilities plus projectiles have a small Corrosive burst.

items.name: Kuva Shildeg
items.description: A crushing, killing, rocket-powered stab-hammer. Grineer, naturally.

items.name: Kuva Sobek
items.description: The Kuva Sobek's exceptional Reload Speed, Critical Chance, and Status Chance make it a natural fit for the Kuva Lich's dominant spirit.

items.name: Kuva Tonkor
items.description: This Lich-variant grenade launcher hurls mayhem and destruction with an increased Reload Speed.

items.name: Kuva Twin Stubbas
items.description: Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.

items.name: Kuva Zarr
items.description: An even stronger Zarr cannon to meet the demands of Kuva Liches. With stronger explosive barrages, and long-range flak shots.

items.name: Lacera
items.description: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.

items.name: Lacerten
items.description: Hound melee attacks devastate with Impact and Slash Damage.

items.name: Laetum
items.description: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.

incarnon.name: Native Incarnon
incarnon.description: Incarnon transformations and evolutions are built into this weapon.

items.name: Landslide Fists

items.name: Landslide Fists Prime

items.name: Lanka

items.name: Larkspur
items.description: From death blooms the Larkspur. A unique and menacing Archgun with a wild initial attack that locks onto a target then chains other targets close to the first. It also sports an explosive projectile mode. In Hildryn's grip the Larkspur carries more reserve ammo.

items.name: Larkspur Prime
items.description: Embrace pandemonium. Chainfire and explosive potential meet in Larkspur Prime. Hildryn packs more ammo when she wields this mighty weapon.

items.description: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. items.description: Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.

items.name: Prisma Burst Laser
items.description: Fires a small burst of lasers.

items.name: Prisma Dual Cleavers
items.description: Blades of energized prisma crystal make these ornamental cleavers cut as sharply as they look.

items.name: Prisma Dual Decurions
items.description: Colder than space and less forgiving, Prisma crystals bring elite efficiency to the already sleek Dual Decurion. Requiring the lightest of touches to reload, these twin archguns prove that heavy weaponry can still possess elegance.

items.name: Prisma Gorgon
items.description: Adorned with void hardened prisma crystal, this Gorgon variant is prized for its beauty and enhanced mechanics.

incarnon.name: Gorgon Incarnon Genesis
incarnon.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire embedding projectiles that explode with Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.

items.name: Prisma Grakata
items.description: Encased in plates refined from pure prisma crystals, this rare element gives this assault rifle a radiant luster.

items.name: Prisma Grinlok
items.description: Prisma-crystal enhancement creates here a prestige instrument; a weapon capable of taking life at astonishing range with but a single pull of its exquisitely-tooled trigger.

items.name: Prisma Lenz
items.description: The explosive potential of the Lenz, enhanced with Prisma crystals.

items.name: Prisma Machete
items.description: The addition of Prisma Crystal allows this otherwise barbaric weapon to elegantly hack through any foe.

items.name: Prisma Obex
items.description: Dazzle, distract and destroy with these sparring weapons of impossibly hard prisma crystal.

incarnon.name: Obex Incarnon Genesis
incarnon.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to perform a large radial attack for each Finisher hit in Incarnon Form.

items.name: Prisma Ohma
items.description: Prisma crystals glisten in these electrified tonfas.

items.name: Prisma Skana
items.description: Forged from raw prisma crystals and infused with Void energy, this blade's pristine edge is honed razor-sharp to eviscerate even the most deadly of foes.

incarnon.name: Skana Incarnon Genesis
incarnon.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to stun nearby enemies when it enters Incarnon Form and after Finisher attacks.

items.name: Prisma Tetra
items.description: When bathed in Void energy and prisma crystal, the simple Tetra becomes a beacon of style and intimidation.

items.name: Prisma Twin Gremlins
items.description: Fused with prisma crystals, these pristine Grineer sidearms are sure to intimidate any foe.

items.name: Prisma Veritux
items.description: A rare object of beauty, this Archwing sword has been sheathed in prisma crystal and baptized in the Void’s energy.

items.name: Proboscis Cernos
items.description: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.

items.name: Tenet Agendus
items.description: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.

items.name: Tenet Arca Plasmor
items.description: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.

items.name: Tenet Cycron
items.description: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.

items.name: Tenet Detron
items.description: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.

items.name: Tenet Diplos
items.description: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.

items.name: Tenet Envoy
items.description: This discreet rocket launcher is equally at home in a board meeting or on a casual outing. Aimed rockets are wire-guided for greater accuracy, but travel more slowly. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the weapon when holstered.

items.name: Tenet Exec
items.description: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.

items.name: Tenet Ferrox
items.description: The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.

items.name: Tenet Flux Rifle
items.description: Sister-modified Flux Rifle with increased fire rate and range. Recharge has been replaced with ammo clips to accommodate greater power needs.

items.name: Tenet Glaxion
items.description: Advances in microelectronics have improved a Corpus classic. Tenet Glaxion’s photon beam strikes up to four enemies at once. It also boasts superior Damage, Critical Chance, and Status Chance.

items.name: Tenet Grigori
items.description: On Heavy Slide Attack, this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

items.name: Tenet Livia
items.description: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

items.name: Tenet Plinx
items.description: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.

items.name: Tenet Quanta
items.description: Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta's lethality even further.

items.name: Tenet Spirex
items.description: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.

items.name: Tenet Tetra
items.description: Parvosian upgrade of the classic Tetra. Slower fire rate but with a larger magazine. Can now alt-fire entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.

items.name: Tenora
items.description: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.

items.name: Tenora Prime
items.description: Add lethal staccato percussion to Octavia's melodies with this masterpiece assault rifle.
